title: Terminal UI change in a Rust workspace (follow `.cursor/rules.md`: no unwrap/expect in production code, rustfmt, docs).…
summary: Agent rows in the PROJECTS tab now show their code at the far right, after the time. Shorter codes are padded so all codes start in the same column. The renderer and the button hit-testing both get the right-hand text from one shared value, so they can't drift. Tests, the `aura-desktop` check, fmt and clippy all pass.
